title: FDR's foreknowledge of Pearl Harbor

tellings.quote: he sent the personal order the night before the attack on December December 7th he ordered all the aircraft carriers to leave under the cover of night

plain: The lawyer Dan Sheehan says that on the night before the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, on December 7, 1941, President Franklin D. Roosevelt sent a personal order for all the aircraft carriers to leave the harbor under cover of darkness. Sheehan passes this on as something he was told. If true, it would mean Roosevelt knew the attack was coming.
